untrusted_historical_priors.source: Historical repo finding F-030 (UNTRUSTED under measurement-integrity assumption)
untrusted_historical_priors.statement: Regime-level volatility is predictable but NOT consumable in spot long/short payoff space. Any node whose thesis routes a volatility forecast into a directional spot payoff is architecturally constrained until a volatility-consuming payoff space is wired.
untrusted_historical_priors.effect: Do NOT treat as architectural law. May motivate clean replication (E-VOL-00, E-P2-01, E-VOL-DIR) but must not close directional or non-directional consumption regions a priori.

meta.governing_assumption: Repository findings, backtests, lineage verdicts, profitability claims, nulls, and falsifications are not admissible as finalized economic evidence until bugs are resolved and the measurement pipeline is revalidated.
